content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

PayPal and Stripe dominate the online payment landscape but their offerings come with severe limitations for users in excluded countries. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many without access. PayPal, notorious for sudden account suspensions, can freeze funds for up to 180 days, creating uncertainty for sellers. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, provides creators with complete control over their sales, payment processing, and data, effectively eliminating reliance on traditional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both PayPal and Stripe systematically exclude users based on geographical location, often without transparency. This exclusion means creators in regions like Zimbabwe or Venezuela face significant barriers to selling digital products. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built to bypass these restrictions. By utilizing tools like NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can sell their ebooks and digital goods without the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors, thus achieving true financial sovereignty.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed is critical for digital creators. Traditional platforms like PayPal can take days to process transactions and impose varied fees that eat into profits. For instance, PayPal's fees range from 2.9% to 4.4%, depending on the transaction type. On the other hand, using NOWPayments with sovereign commerce stacks incurs just a 0.5% fee, with instant payment confirmation once a transaction occurs on-chain. Creators can therefore receive funds faster and at a significantly lower cost, maintaining better control over their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees you own your data and payment processes.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant trade-offs when using platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy is ownership. These platforms often retain control over customer data and product delivery, meaning creators are at their mercy. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators own their entire stack, from hosting to payment processing. They have automated workflows that ensure instant delivery upon purchase, giving them peace of mind and full control over their business operations without the risk of third-party interference.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Deciding on the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you’re looking to launch quickly with minimal setup, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack for a straightforward solution. For those needing more versatility and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced features, including configuration for SPF/DKIM/DMARC to enhance deliverability and security. This stack can be deployed in 48 hours, giving you a rapid route to market without the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
No more account suspensions or frozen funds – enjoy financial freedom.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
